title: Front Desk Manager
description:
Job Description Front Desk Manager Company: BeatBox Fitness
 Position: Front Desk Manager
 Experience: 0–5 Years
 Locations: Kokapet, Hyderabad Electronic City, Bengaluru Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Mode: Onsite
 Candidate Preference: Open to All Candidates 
 About BeatBox Fitness 
 BeatBox Fitness is a modern, high-energy fitness studio offering a unique combination of boxing, strength training, functional workouts, and an engaging studio experience . We are looking for energetic and customer-focused Front Desk Managers to join our teams at Kokapet, Hyderabad and Electronic City, Bengaluru . 
 Job Summary 
 The Front Desk Manager will be responsible for managing day-to-day front desk operations, welcoming members and prospects, handling customer inquiries, coordinating trial sessions and memberships, supporting sales activities, and ensuring a smooth and professional experience for every visitor. Candidates with 0–5 years of experience can apply. Freshers with excellent communication skills, confidence, and a customer-friendly attitude are also encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Welcome members, guests, and prospective customers in a friendly and professional manner. Manage daily front desk and reception activities. Handle walk-in inquiries, calls, WhatsApp messages, and customer queries. Explain BeatBox Fitness programs, membership plans, trial sessions, and available offers. Follow up with leads and assist in converting inquiries into memberships. Schedule trial sessions, fitness classes, consultations, and appointments. Manage member registrations, renewals, payments, and basic documentation. Maintain accurate customer and lead information in the CRM or internal system. Coordinate with fitness trainers, sales staff, and studio management. Track member attendance and follow up with inactive or potential members. Handle customer concerns and provide timely solutions. Support studio events, promotional activities, and member-engagement initiatives. Maintain a clean, professional, and welcoming front desk area. Prepare daily reports related to walk-ins, leads, follow-ups, memberships, and collections. Assist with opening and closing procedures as required. 
 Required Skills 
 0–5 years of experience in Front Desk, Customer Service, Sales, Hospitality, Fitness, Reception, or Administration. Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome. Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Friendly, confident, presentable, and customer-oriented personality. Basic computer knowledge, including Excel and CRM usage. Strong follow-up and organizational skills. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable interacting with customers and explaining membership plans. Willingness to work flexible shifts and weekends as per studio requirements. Interest in fitness and wellness will be an added advantage. 
 Who Can Apply 
 Freshers and experienced candidates with 0–5 years of experience Male and Female candidates Candidates with good communication and customer-handling skills Candidates comfortable working onsite Immediate joiners will be preferred

 Company: Tata AutoComp Systems Ltd. Purpose of the Role The Senior Engineer - Import & Export will be responsible for managing end-to-end international procurement activities, import-export operations, customs compliance, logistics coordination, and supplier management for BESS projects. The role will ensure timely availability of imported materials, optimize logistics costs, and maintain regulatory compliance for global sourcing activities. Key Responsibilities Import & Export Operations Manage end-to-end import and export activities for BESS components, battery systems, electrical and mechanical parts. Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, and logistics service providers. Ensure timely customs clearance and delivery of imported materials to manufacturing locations. Monitor shipment schedules and proactively address delays or logistics issues. International Procurement Support Support global sourcing initiatives by coordinating with overseas suppliers. Analyze quotations, Incoterms, freight costs, duties, and landed costs. Execute purchase orders and track deliveries from international suppliers. Ensure continuity of supply for critical imported components. Customs & Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with DGFT, Customs, FEMA, GST, and other applicable import-export regulations. Manage documentation such as Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Bill of Lading, Airway Bills, Certificates of Origin, and Insurance documents. Coordinate duty optimization initiatives under applicable schemes and trade agreements. Maintain accurate import-export records for audits and statutory requirements. Logistics & Cost Management Optimize freight and logistics costs through effective vendor negotiations. Monitor inventory in transit and reduce lead times. Develop logistics performance metrics and supplier scorecards. Support budgeting and cost-saving initiatives related to international supply chain operations. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Purchase, Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, and Project teams. Work closely with global suppliers to resolve shipment and documentation issues. Support new project sourcing requirements and localization initiatives. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Production Engineering. Additional certification in EXIM Management, Supply Chain Management, or International Trade preferred. Experience 5 to 8 years of experience in Import & Export operations, International Procurement, or Global Supply Chain Management. Experience in Automotive, EV, Battery Manufacturing, Energy Storage, Power Electronics, or Industrial Manufacturing preferred. Exposure to international sourcing and customs regulations is mandatory. Required Skills Import-Export Documentation & Compliance International Procurement & Sourcing DGFT & Customs Regulations Freight Forwarding & Logistics Management Incoterms and International Trade Practices Vendor Management & Negotiation SAP / ERP Systems Cost Analysis & Landed Cost Calculation Supply Chain Planning Strong Communication & Stakeholder Management Key Competencies Analytical Thinking Problem Solving Negotiation Skills Attention to Detail Cross-functional Collaboration Customer Focus Result Orientation Planning & Execution Excellence Preferred Industry Experience Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Electric Vehicle (EV) Automotive Components Energy Storage & Renewable Energy Power Electronics & Electrical Systems

JOB DESCRIPTION ACCOUNTANT 
 Job Title: Accountant 
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Company: Vibrant Construction Equipments Pvt. Ltd.

 Shift: Day Shift
 Experience: Minimum 2 Years
 Industry Preference: Manufacturing / Engineering Industry 
 Interested candidates can share their updated CV at: Email: hr@vibrantengineering.com
 Contact: 9247571581 
 Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Jr. Accountant to support the day-to-day accounting and finance operations of our manufacturing organization. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accounting records, handling financial documentation, supporting statutory compliance, reconciliations, and assisting with monthly financial reporting. The ideal candidate should have at least 2 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment , with practical knowledge of accounting processes, GST, TDS, and ERP/accounting software. Key Responsibilities Maintain day-to-day accounting records and financial transactions. Record journal entries, payment vouchers, receipts, purchase and sales transactions. Handle Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities. Prepare and maintain bank, vendor, customer, and ledger reconciliations . Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices, bills, vouchers, debit notes, and credit notes. Ensure proper accounting and documentation of purchase and expense transactions. Support GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and Professional Tax related documentation and compliance activities. Assist in GST reconciliation and invoice verification . Coordinate with vendors and internal departments for invoice and payment-related documentation. Assist in payroll data verification and salary-related accounting activities. Prepare basic MIS and financial reports using Microsoft Excel . Maintain proper documentation and filing of accounting records. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Assist internal and statutory auditors by providing required financial records and supporting documents. Monitor outstanding receivables and payables and coordinate with concerned departments. Assist in inventory and stock-related accounting/documentation wherever required. Coordinate with Stores, Purchase, Sales, HR, and other departments for financial documentation. Ensure accuracy and timely updating of accounting records in the ERP/accounting system. Perform other accounting and finance-related duties assigned by the Finance & Accounts team. Eligibility Criteria B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance. Candidates with experience in a manufacturing or engineering company will be preferred. Practical experience in accounting operations, reconciliations, invoicing, and statutory documentation is required. Candidates should be willing to work from the company's Sultanpur, Hyderabad location. Required Skills Strong understanding of basic accounting principles. Hands-on experience with Tally Prime / Tally ERP or other ERP accounting software . Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Outlook . Knowledge of ledger, bank, vendor, and customer reconciliations. Good understanding of accounting documentation and bookkeeping. Strong numerical and analytical skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to work independently as well as in a team. Ability to manage multiple accounting activities within deadlines. Preferred Skills Working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and Professional Tax . Experience in manufacturing/engineering accounting . Knowledge of purchase, sales, inventory, and expense accounting. Exposure to ERP-based accounting systems. Experience in assisting with internal and statutory audits. Good knowledge of Excel functions and preparation of MIS reports. Key Competencies Integrity and confidentiality Attention to detail Numerical accuracy Time management Problem-solving ability Teamwork and collaboration Accountability and ownership Willingness to learn Ability to work under deadlines Compensation & Benefits Competitive salary based on experience and company standards. On-the-job learning and professional development opportunities. Statutory benefits as per company policy. Career growth opportunities within the organization. Opportunity to work in a manufacturing and engineering environment. Experience Minimum 2 Years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance 
 Preferred: Candidates with experience in Manufacturing / Engineering Industry.

title: Walk-in || Senior Accountant
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 24 Sep - 30 Sep
Timing: 11.00 AM - 3.00 PM
Venue: H-102, MAIN MARKET, SARITA  VIHAR, NEAR POST OFFICE, 1ST FLOOR, NEW DELHI , NEAREST METRO SARITA VIHAR
Contact: ASHISH MITTAL (9810354808)

Job Description We are looking for an experienced, responsible and highly accountable Senior Accountant / Accounts In-Charge who can independently manage the day-to-day accounting, statutory compliance, banking, receivables, payables and inventory-related accounting of the company. The candidate should be hands-on, systematic, disciplined and responsible for the accuracy, completeness and timely completion of all assigned accounting work . Key Responsibilities Handle complete day-to-day accounting of the company. Prepare and file GST Returns , including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other applicable GST compliances. Reconcile GST input/output and ensure correctness of GST records. Handle TDS calculations, deductions, payments and TDS returns . Perform daily bank reconciliation for all company bank accounts. Monitor bank entries and ensure that all receipts and payments are properly accounted for. Prepare sales invoices, tax invoices, debit notes and credit notes. Handle e-Invoicing and E-Way Bills , wherever applicable. Check invoices for correct rates, quantities, GST and other commercial details. Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. Perform regular customer and vendor reconciliation . Monitor outstanding receivables and prepare customer ageing reports. Follow up internally regarding overdue customer payments. Maintain and verify accounts payable and accounts receivable. Ensure that purchases, sales and expenses are correctly booked under appropriate accounting heads. Reconcile stock/inventory records with accounts . Verify incoming stock, purchase entries and supporting documents. Ensure that stock received is properly entered against the relevant Purchase Order / GRN / supplier invoice. Identify discrepancies between physical stock, software stock and accounting records. Maintain proper accounting records for the concerned company/business entity. Conduct ledger scrutiny and identify incorrect, duplicate or missing entries. Prepare monthly accounting reports and reconciliations. Assist in month-end and year-end closing. Coordinate with CA / auditors for GST, TDS, statutory compliance and audit requirements. Maintain complete supporting documentation and proper filing of accounting records. Ensure that statutory payments and returns are completed before their respective due dates. Daily End-of-Day Reporting Mandatory The Accounts In-Charge will be required to submit a Daily End-of-Day Accounts Report before leaving the office . The daily report should clearly mention: Bank reconciliation status. Payments received from customers. Payments made to suppliers and other parties. Customer outstanding / overdue payment status. Invoices generated during the day. Purchase entries completed. Debit notes / credit notes issued or pending. GST / TDS work completed or pending. Stock or inventory discrepancies noticed. Customer / supplier reconciliation completed. Any accounting issue, discrepancy or pending approval. Work completed during the day. Work pending at the end of the day. Reason for any pending work. Priority work planned for the next working day. No important accounting work should remain pending without being mentioned in the Daily End-of-Day Report. Accountability & Ownership This position requires a person who takes complete ownership and accountability for the assigned work . The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that: Assigned work is completed within the required timeline. Accounting entries are accurate and supported by proper documents. GST and TDS compliances are completed correctly and on time. Bank reconciliation is updated regularly. Customer outstanding is properly monitored. Customer and vendor ledgers are properly reconciled. Stock received and stock appearing in accounts/software are properly matched. Mistakes, discrepancies or missing documents are identified and reported immediately. Incorrect or incomplete information is not ignored. Pending work is reported clearly instead of being carried forward without explanation. Management is informed immediately if any issue can affect accounts, taxation, payments, customer outstanding or statutory compliance. Daily reports reflect the actual status of work and should not contain incorrect or misleading information. The employee will be accountable for the correctness and completion of the work handled by him/her and is expected to verify the work rather than simply enter data into the system. Candidate Requirements Education: B.Com / M.Com preferred. CA Inter candidates with relevant practical experience may also apply. Experience: Minimum 4–8 years of practical accounting experience . Experience in a manufacturing company will be strongly preferred. Required Skills The candidate must have good practical knowledge of: GST GSTR-1 GSTR-3B GST Reconciliation TDS TDS Returns Bank Reconciliation Accounts Receivable Accounts Payable Customer Outstanding Vendor Reconciliation Customer Reconciliation Sales Invoicing Purchase Accounting Debit Notes / Credit Notes E-Invoicing E-Way Bills Inventory / Stock Reconciliation Ledger Scrutiny Tally Prime / ERP Accounting Software MS Excel Daily MIS / Management Reporting Most Important Requirement We are looking for a person who takes ownership of the work and reports the actual position to management every day . The candidate should not merely make accounting entries. He/she must verify whether the entries, balances, invoices, bank transactions, statutory returns and stock records are correct. The person should be capable of independently identifying: What work has been completed. What work is pending. Why it is pending. What discrepancy has been found. Who needs to take action. What needs to be completed next. Preferred Candidate We prefer a candidate who is: Responsible and accountable. Detail-oriented. Strong in numbers and reconciliation. Able to work independently. Disciplined about deadlines. Regular in submitting daily reports. Good at maintaining proper documentation. Comfortable checking the work rather than simply entering data. Able to identify mistakes and resolve discrepancies. Honest and transparent in reporting. Able to take complete responsibility for assigned accounting functions. Willing to report problems immediately rather than hide or postpone them.

Key Skills: GST Return,Tally ERP,Accounts Finalisation,Bank Reconciliation,TDS Return,Book Keeping,Tally,Senior

The Role In this role, you will uncover the insights and intelligence that help customers in dynamic, dataintensive industries operate, scale, and innovate. You will develop robust, futureready machine learning and analytical models that enable predictive insights, automation, and datadriven decision making across complex digital transformation programmes. With access to modern data platforms, highquality datasets, and advanced statistical and AI frameworks, you will work closely with engineering, product, and analytics teams to build solutions that are accurate, explainable, and scalable. This role empowers you to shape endtoend analytical ecosystemsaccelerating delivery, enhancing decision quality, strengthening operational resilience, and guiding organisations toward a more insightrich, AIenabled future. Your responsibilities: (Up to 10, Avoid repetition) Explore, clean, and analyse large, complex datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and opportunities that drive actionable insights. Develop, train, and validate machine learning, statistical, and predictive models that solve real business problems and deliver measurable impact. Design and run experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis tests, simulations) to evaluate ideas, quantify outcomes, and guide decisionmaking. Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, product managers, and domain experts to translate business requirements into welldefined modelling tasks. Build endtoend ML pipelines—from feature engineering and preprocessing to deploymentready model outputs. Apply advanced techniques such as NLP, timeseries forecasting, anomaly detection, optimisation, or LLM/GenAI methods where relevant. Implement model evaluation frameworks using offline metrics, crossvalidation, online experiments, and humanintheloop feedback loops. Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, visualisations, written summaries, and presentations tailored to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Ensure models are interpretable and explainable where required, providing transparency into key drivers and assumptions. Work with engineering teams to deploy models into production, monitor performance, and retrain or recalibrate as data and conditions change. Your Profile Essential skills/knowledge/experience: (Up to 10, Avoid repetition) Role- Data Scientist ( 5 to 12 Yrs ) Hands-on experience with GenAI, Gemini or Open source LLMs and develop GenAI applications for Code Translation, Text Extraction, Summarisation and SDLC Optimization etc. Hands-on Experience with AI Agents, Chat bots, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and vector databases. ( PG vector / croma DB ) Hands-on Experience with GenAI Performance Evaluation tools like Pegasus, Ragas, DeepEval Create Conversational Interface with React JS or other Frontend components, Develop and deploy AI agents using LangGraph and ADK, A2A, MCP Strong programming skills in Python (experience with LangChain/LangGraph / LangSmith frameworks) and TypeScript ( preferable ) Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and graph-based workflows. Knowledge and implementation of Input and Output guardrails in addressing Hallucination, PII filtering, HAP and Bias etc. Implemented security best practices, Experience to address spikes and Denial of wallet attacks, DDoS attack and other Spike arrest strategies Knowledge of API Gateways and ISTIO , ability to Diagnose and intercept failures in End to End communication Hands-on Experience with API Development and Microservices architecture Desirable skills/knowledge/experience: (As applicable) Strong experience applying machine learning, statistical modelling, and predictive analytics to realworld business problems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ability to resolve end to end connectivity and Data Integrations Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis. Familiarity with LLMs, NLP techniques, and GenAI frameworks, including embeddings, prompt engineering, or finetuning. Experience building endtoend ML pipelines, including model validation, optimisation, deployment, and monitoring. Understanding of MLOps practices, including model versioning, model registries, CI/CD for ML, and automated training/inference workflows. Ability to translate business problems into analytical tasks and communicate insights in a clear, concise manner to technical and nontechnical audiences. Knowledge of data governance, including data quality, lineage, ethics, privacy considerations, and responsible AI principles. Lead the transition toward Headless / Decoupled Content Delivery and composable Digital Experience Platforms (DXP) via RESTful APIs and GraphQL. Technical Leadership & Governance: 
 Establish architectural blueprints, code quality standards, component design libraries, and technical governance models across full-stack development teams. Perform high-level code reviews, component design approvals, and performance profiling across both backend (.NET) and frontend (Vue.js) layers. Frontend & Experience Engineering: 
 Architect modern, high-performance user interfaces utilizing Vue.js , Vuex/Pinia , and Vue Router , ensuring cross-browser compatibility, web accessibility (WCAG), and SEO optimization. Design reusable component architectures that seamlessly integrate with Optimizely's content delivery APIs. Backend & CMS Engineering: 
 Design robust .NET Core / C# microservices, background processing jobs, content schemas, and page/block structures within Optimizely. Implement custom Optimizely plugins, scheduled jobs, workflow extensions, and search integrations (Optimizely Graph / Search & Navigation). Integration & Cloud Infrastructure: 
 Architect third-party integrations with CRM, ERP, DAM, PIM, Payment Gateways, and Analytics platforms. Oversee application deployment strategies on Azure App Services , Optimizely DXP (Azure PaaS) , and configure automated CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions). Stakeholder Engagement & Problem Solving: 
 Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and UX/UI Designers to convert business requirements into actionable technical roadmap decisions. Identify technical risks, evaluate performance bottlenecks, and resolve complex security, caching, or scalability challenges. Required Profile (Essential Skills & Experience) Core Experience: 10+ years of full-stack web engineering experience, with 3+ years operating in an Architecture / Technical Lead role . Optimizely Expertise: Proven experience architecting solutions on Optimizely CMS / Episerver (preferably v12+ on .NET Core) and familiarity with Optimizely DXP deployment models. Backend Proficiency: Deep hands-on mastery of C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API , Entity Framework, and cloud-native microservice architecture. Frontend Mastery: Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue.js (Vue 2/3, Vuex/Pinia, SSR with Nuxt.js) . Integrations & APIs: Proven track record in API-first design using REST, GraphQL , and asynchronous messaging/queues. Cloud & DevOps: Direct experience with Microsoft Azure , Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and CDN/Caching configurations (Cloudflare/Akamai). Database & Data Modeling: Expert knowledge of SQL Server , database indexing, caching strategies (Redis), and data architecture for high-traffic sites.
